title: Gorengan Terakhir
setting: Cozy Indonesian street food stall (warung) at night, string lights, a plate of fried snacks (gorengan) on a wooden table, glasses of iced tea.
caption: Gorengan terakhir itu sakral 😤 #chibi

scenes.image_prompt: Close shot of Raka staring intensely at the LAST piece of gorengan (a fried tofu) on the plate, eyes sparkling, hands rubbing together, dramatic spotlight on the snack.
scenes.motion_prompt: Dramatic slow zoom onto the fried tofu. Raka slowly reaches out his hand like a samurai about to draw a sword. Tense drum roll.

scenes.image_prompt: Gue suddenly zooms in from the side frame on a tiny skateboard, mouth wide open, snatching the fried tofu right before Raka's fingers touch it; motion lines, Raka's eyes wide in shock.
scenes.motion_prompt: Gue zips through the frame from left to right on a skateboard and snatches the tofu in one bite. Raka's hand grabs empty air. Freeze on Raka's shocked face.
scenes.audio: whoosh, skateboard rolling, loud crunch bite

scenes.image_prompt: Raka kneels on the ground in anime-style despair, rain cloud over his head, holding the empty plate, single tear, the warung owner in the background offering a bill.
scenes.motion_prompt: A tiny rain cloud pours only on Raka. He slowly raises the empty plate to the sky and cries dramatically. Sad violin.
